defect: DebugString appends the uint32_t max_column_family_ with std::string::append instead of AppendNumberTo, which does not produce the number (ill-formed or wrong output).
reason: The fix replaces exactly the r.append(max_column_family_) line this change added with AppendNumberTo, as every other numeric field in the function already does.

defect: The fix checks the fstat() return value before dividing by st_blksize/512; the unchecked fstat and the division predate this change.
reason: The change only removed the static buggy flag and warning; the division using possibly garbage fstat results was already executed before it.

defect: The new public CompactionOptionsFIFO constructor declares the boolean allow_compaction parameter as uint64_t, causing a forced bool conversion warning (error under MSVC warnings-as-errors) in user builds.
reason: The fix changes exactly this newly added parameter type from uint64_t to bool.

defect: The same change passed no_io as the for_compaction argument of BlockReader in table.cc, so KeyMayExist read blocks from disk, and the test lines it added assert value_found true after Flush to enshrine that wrong behaviour.
reason: The fix corrects the BlockReader call in table.cc and the wrong assertion this change added in db_test.cc; seeing it requires the BlockReader default-argument signature.

defect: The timestamp GC logic added by this change compares ikey_.user_key with current_user_key_ after SetInternalKey has made them equal, and keeps only a Slice current_ts_ so the previous key timestamp is not available for comparison.
reason: The fix repairs the comparison order in compaction_iterator.cc and changes the header members and UpdateTimestampAndCompareWithFullHistoryLow added by this change to keep a copied timestamp.

defect: The fix recomputes the size budget after regenerating the SST files to remove flakiness in ManualCompactionMax.
reason: This change only initialized the averages and rewrote an algebraically identical formula; the use of stale sizes from an earlier generation predates it.

defect: seqno_time_cadence is computed as min_time_duration / kMaxSeqnoTimePairsPerCF, which truncates to 0 (no recording) when preclude_last_level_data_seconds is smaller than the constant.
reason: The fix rounds up exactly the division this change added in RegisterRecordSeqnoTimeWorker, where 0 already means no worker.

defect: The fix re-adds a default value for the stride parameter because later merged code calls gen_l0_kb with two arguments.
reason: This change removed the default and updated every call in its version; the two-argument calls that broke the build came from later commits.

defect: The fix makes the helper MinLevelToCompress return a bool so the calling test can skip when compression is unavailable.
reason: In this change the early return was inside the TEST body itself and correctly skipped the test; the void helper was introduced by a later refactor.

defect: The new ROCKS_LOG_DEBUG calls dereference txn (GetName, GetSnapshot) even on the DBInsert path where txn is nullptr.
reason: The fix guards exactly these added log statements with txn != nullptr; the surrounding code visibly handles txn == nullptr.

defect: The fix only renames the variable cf_to_use to db_idx_to_use.
reason: A rename is a style change with no behavioural defect.

defect: The fix adds pending_manifest_file_number to DeletionState to close a race in manifest rolling.
reason: This change only moved DeletionState and the obsolete-file methods to public; the manifest roll race lies in VersionSet::LogAndApply logic it did not touch.

defect: The fix introduces pending_manifest_file_number_ to avoid deleting the manifest during a roll race.
reason: This change only reformatted the arguments of a NewWritableFile call; the race predates it.

defect: PrintStatsSummary increments cf_num_accesses by one per caller entry instead of adding num_accesses, so the per column family access count is wrong.
reason: The fix changes exactly this line of the new file, which is visibly inconsistent with the other counters next to it.

defect: The fix samples on the block_key parameter instead of record.block_key.
reason: At this change record.block_key held the key; a later commit (7a8d7358) moved the key into a separate parameter and left ShouldTrace hashing the now unset field.

defect: The new DeleteFileRange test stores the size_t result of CountFiles() in int32_t, which breaks the clang build (shorten-64-to-32 as error).
reason: The fix changes exactly these two added declarations to size_t; seeing it needs the CountFiles return type from db_test_util.h.

defect: The fix makes FillDB flush by default and removes the explicit flushes, to remove flakiness in other backup tests.
reason: The flushes this change added were correct; the later fix is a test refactor targeting other flaky tests.

defect: kFlagMin is initialized in-class with std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max(), which is not a constant expression on MSVC without constexpr support, breaking the Windows build.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this changed initializer with the UINT64_MAX macro to fix the Windows constexpr build failure.

defect: The new file calls std::pow while including only <math.h>, not <cmath>, so it fails to compile where std::pow is not pulled in transitively (clang on Mac).
reason: The fix replaces exactly this std::pow call added by the change to repair the compile error.

defect: The fix handles a partition size below the minimum filter size (keys_per_partition_ of 0) in PartitionedFilterBlockBuilder and adjusts the test metadata_block_size.
reason: The keys_per_partition_ computation that misbehaves predates this change; the new test only exposed it on platforms with larger cache lines.

defect: The fix rewords stress test error messages to contain error/fail keywords the crash test scans for.
reason: This is a diagnostic wording improvement applied to old and new messages alike; the new checks themselves behave correctly.

defect: The new default argument std::map<std::string, Status> status = {} on VerifyDBFromMap makes tests fail under GCC 4.8.1.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added default argument with an explicit std::map constructor call; the failure stems from a compiler quirk not visible in the code.

defect: The fix records the SEQUENCE_NUMBER ticker with SetTickerCount(last_sequence) instead of RecordTick(batch count).
reason: Within RocksDB statistics the increments keep the ticker equal to the last sequence; the switch only suits an external statistics consumer and is a design choice, not a repaired defect.

defect: The two new BLOOM_FILTER_PREFIX tickers are appended to the enum but inserted in the middle of TickersNameMap, breaking the enum-order correspondence that consumers of the public map rely on.
reason: The fix moves exactly these two map entries to the end; the dependence on positional order lives in consumers outside this file.

defect: The new wrapper returns early on an Incomplete status from a partitioned internal index (infinite loop), adds the UDI meta block too late to be written, and passes internal keys instead of user keys to the user defined index.
reason: The fix changes Finish and OnKeyAdded of this new file; recognizing the problems needs the partitioned index and table builder contracts.

defect: The new upper bound rate_limiter_drains <= elapsed / 100000 ignores a drain in the final partial interval, making RateLimitingTest flaky.
reason: The fix relaxes exactly these added assertions by one for the truncated partial interval.

defect: The fix stops TableCache from keeping a reference to a temporary FileOptions converted from the Repairer EnvOptions member.
reason: Passing env_options_ to TableCache predates this change, which only added the db_session_id argument and reformatted the call.

defect: The new CurrentFileModifiedWhileCheckpointing2PC test leaks every transaction created in the loop, the named transaction txn and the TransactionDB txdb.
reason: The fix adds the missing deletes for tx, txn and txdb in the test this change added, curing the valgrind failure.

defect: The new assertions compare int GetNumProbesFromFilterData() with uint32_t SelectByImpl(), a signed/unsigned mismatch that fails MSVC builds with warnings as errors.
reason: The fix adds the cast in exactly the comparisons this change introduced (other cast fixes in that commit touch older lines).

defect: The fix guards an underflow in UpdateCacheReservationRatio and makes sec_cache_res_ratio_ atomic.
reason: UpdateCacheReservationRatio and dynamic changes of the ratio were added later; in this change the ratio is set only in the constructor.

defect: When the internal buffer is handed out, the result slice starts at buf.BufferStart() without adding offset_advance, returning the wrong bytes for unaligned direct IO reads.
reason: The fix adds offset_advance to exactly this line introduced by the change; the copy branch next to it visibly uses offset_advance.

defect: The fix removes the shared mutable copy_file_buffer_size_ that concurrent restores race on.
reason: The rate limiter code writing copy_file_buffer_size_ is context that predates this change, which added atomic CURRENT rename and fsync.

defect: For compaction reads the prefetch reads only readahead_size_ bytes even when n is larger, so the returned slice of n bytes overruns the buffer (checksum mismatches, heap overflow).
reason: The fix changes exactly this added Prefetch call to read std::max(n, readahead_size_).

defect: The new ClearFlushedFiles clears flushed_files_ without taking mutex_, racing with OnFlushCompleted on the flush thread.
reason: The fix adds the lock to exactly this added method; the other members visibly lock mutex_.

defect: The fix excludes hash_table_bench from Windows builds because it includes port_posix.h.
reason: The port_posix include predates this change, and the Windows break came from a later commit adding persistent cache to the Windows build.

defect: write_buffer_count() returns a double expression implicitly converted to size_t, a narrowing warning that breaks the Windows build with warnings as errors.
reason: The fix adds the static_cast to exactly this line of the new header, which landed after persistent cache joined the Windows build.

defect: The fix comments out unused parameter names in the default EventListener callbacks.
reason: This is a warning cleanup applied to all callbacks, following a pattern that existed before this change.

defect: The added GetReadableProperties returns {} for an std::unordered_map typedef, which some supported compilers reject (copy-list-initialization with the explicit default constructor).
reason: The fix replaces exactly this return {} with an explicit UserCollectedProperties{}; the typedef lives in table_properties.h.

defect: The new ConcurrentMergeWrite test shares one MemTablePostProcessInfo between two concurrent insert threads, a data race.
reason: The fix gives each thread its own MemTablePostProcessInfo in the test this change added.

defect: The added short-circuit in MemTable::Get returns NotFound whenever a covering range tombstone was seen, discarding newer merge operands already collected and returning a wrong result.
reason: The fix removes exactly these four added lines; seeing it requires the cross-memtable Get and merge flow.
